outcome.situation_summary: 5 critical accounts with combined $17,315 MRR at immediate risk. All show severe DAU declines (43-68%), low NPS (1-4), and elevated support burdens. NovaWorks renewal is imminent in 2 months ($3,514 MRR). VoltDesk has highest MRR exposure ($10,711) with worst usage collapse (67.6%). 14 of 19 accounts lack sufficient data for analysis.
outcome.memory_summary: Processed 5 accounts with 5 critical and 0 at-risk. Primary risk patterns: (1) severe usage drops (45-67%), (2) extended inactivity (43 days), (3) high support ticket volume (4-10 tickets), and (4) renewal proximity (2 months). All accounts span $292-$10,711 MRR range, indicating broad-based risk. Interventions successfully queued for all 5 accounts across 4 CSMs. No errors encountered. Baseline patterns established for tenant learning.
